# Bid the finish level, not the sheets.

> Price a hang-and-finish drywall job from rooms, waste, openings, ceiling height, and Gypsum Association finish levels 0–5 — not a flat price per square foot. See labor hours, walk-away price, and the margin a $1.50-a-foot special actually leaves.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
